module factory

pub struct Input {
pub:
    enabled bool
}

// make specializes a value in an imported module.
pub fn make[T]() T {
    return T{}
}

// make_heap specializes a heap value in an imported module.
pub fn make_heap[T]() &T {
    return &T{}
}

pub struct FixedInput {
pub:
    enabled bool
}

// make_fixed exercises the fixed-array initialization path.
pub fn make_fixed[T]() T {
    return T{fixed: [11, 22]!}
}
